title: Implement stubbed CRC-16/CCITT
prompt: crc16_ccitt() in crc.c is a stub that returns 0. Implement it as specified in crc.h: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE, polynomial 0x1021, initial value 0xFFFF, MSB-first (no reflection), no final XOR. The check value for the ASCII string "123456789" is 0x29B1. Keep it C89 and table-free.
